text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: AUTH-SIGN-ERRORS (sev=high) — 45% increase in token signing failures across api-redwood-auth in the last 3m.

pagerduty: Incident 5123 created and paged oncall-sre. Click here to join: https://pagerduty.example/incident/5123

oncall-sre: ack'd — I'm on it. grabbing logs and metrics.

anya (SRE): seeing 500s from auth-signer for /v1/token/create, error = "kid not found" for a subset of requests. new token issuance failing, validation of freshly minted tokens also intermittently failing. existing tokens still accepted.

mike (eng): rolling update to signing-service finished 2h ago — could be secondaries not reloading JWKS? checking rollout logs.

lisa (security): possible key propagation lag after rotation? when was last rotation?

mike (eng): we rotated primary signing key at 01:03 UTC (2h3m ago). rollout snippet: `kubectl set image deploy/auth-signer signer=auth-signer:v2.7.1 --record` then gradual rolling. logs show some pods restarted after 01:06 but a couple in eu-west didn't pick up config.

anya (SRE): reproducing locally: curl -v https://auth.redwood.example/v1/.well-known/jwks.json returns the new key set, but some signer pods still request an old kid. suspect caching in the signer process.

oncall-sre: escalation to eng oncall (mike). mike are you available to do a quick hotfix?

mike (eng): oncall here. I'll push a compatibility fallback that accepts both kids from the JWKS and force in-memory reload. Preparing patch.

sam (support): hearing from 3 enterprise customers about failed logins with 401s, one reported integration failing for SSO. I'm drafting a situational update to CS with mitigation steps.

anya (SRE): temporary mitigation options: 1) force signer pods to reload JWKS by hitting /admin/reload-keys if supported, 2) restart affected pods in eu-west, or 3) roll back to previous image while keys stabilize. preference: reload keys then restart if errors persist.

mike (eng): applying #1 now to eu-west signer pods: `for p in $(kubectl -n auth get pods -l app=auth-signer -o name --field-selector=status.phase=Running); do kubectl exec -n auth $p -- curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:8081/admin/reload-keys || true; done`

incident-bot: exec command returned: 3/5 pods reloaded, 2 timed out (connection refused).

anya (SRE): restarting the two timed-out pods: `kubectl delete pod -n auth <podname>` (doing one at a time).

oncall-sre: restarting pod auth-signer-7c8f6 (eu-west-1) — back up.

mike (eng): patch applied to accept missing kid fallback in memory. deploying canary to 1 pod in eu-west: `kubectl apply -f signer-fallback-canary.yaml`

incident-bot: metrics update: token-sign-fail-rate dropped from 45% -> 12% after reloads, then -> 4% after canary. error rate trending down. :thumbsup:

lisa (security): quick check: no evidence of malicious key tampering; rotation metadata matches expected KMS logs.

sam (support): CS update v1 posted to affected customers: "We're investigating intermittent SSO failures due to a signing key propagation issue. New tokens may fail; existing sessions remain valid. Engineering is rolling mitigations. We'll update in 30m."

anya (SRE): continuing to monitor. plan: let canary run 15m, then rollout fix to remaining pods if no regression. tagging incident as P1 and creating incident channel for follow-up.

mike (eng): rolling fix now to remaining pods (eu-west then global). command queued.

incident-bot: rollout started: 4 pods updated.

incident-bot: metrics update (15m): token-sign-fail-rate stable at 1.2%. request latency and error budgets within SLO.

oncall-sre: handing off to next SRE on the 12:00-20:00 shift — @anya will take post-incertion monitoring and postmortem lead.

anya (SRE): acking handoff. I'll create the incident postmortem doc and include timeline, root-cause hypothesis (signer process not reloading JWKS during config rollout), and remediation: make reload idempotent, expose health check for key sync, and add alert that watches for kid mismatch spikes.

lisa (security): recommend we run a controlled key-propagation test in staging and add KMS propagation guardrails.

sam (support): updating CS with resolution note and ETA for postmortem. customers informed.

mike (eng): tagging PR: `fix/signer-jwks-fallback` and linking to incident: https://git.example/redwood/auth/merge_requests/1123

incident-bot: Incident 5123 status -> mitigated. closing page. please follow up with postmortem and any action items assigned. :white_check_mark:

anya (SRE): will schedule RCA meeting 48h and assign owners for remediation tasks. thanks everyone for prompt responses.

sam (support): closing customer-facing thread after PM approves note.

mike (eng): quick note: add a small test harness that hits `admin/reload-keys` during rollout to detect pods that can't reload early. saves us from full restarts next time.

lisa (security): +1 for test harness. also we'll coordinate an inventory of key rotations in the next sprint.

anya (SRE): last check (10m after mitigation): error-rate at 0.6% — monitoring for residual flakiness. marking this thread resolved on Slack.
